points.text: EQUINOR ASA is registered as allmennaksjeselskap (ASA) based in Stavanger, registered under 'Utvinning av råolje', founded 1972-09-18.

Latest filed accounts (2025): revenue 68.0B USD, operating result 5.6B, net result 5.7B; revenue down 6% vs 2024 (calculated).
